authorize.title: Authorize an application
authorize.intro: {name} asks to read your AutoLedger data.
authorize.vehiclesAll: All my vehicles, including the ones I add later
authorize.canVehicles: See your vehicles: name, make, model, powertrain, currency and odometer.
authorize.canCosts: Read what each vehicle costs: the last 12 months and since purchase, by category.
authorize.canGaps: See what is missing from your records (odometer gaps, charges without a cost).
authorize.canNames: See the names and places you recorded: trip addresses, charging places, drivers and carpool passengers, tags, notes and tariff plans.
authorize.cannotTitle: It will not be able to
authorize.cannotPrivate: See VINs, plates, GPS positions or documents.
authorize.returnTo: After your choice you are sent back to {host}.
authorize.unverified: The name is given by the application and is not verified: approve only an application you just started.
authorize.revokeHint: You can end this access at any time from your account page, in the API tokens list.
authorize.approved: Access approved. You can return to the application.
authorize.denied: Access denied. You can close this page.
authorize.invalid: This authorization request is not valid.
authorize.failed: The decision could not be recorded. Try again.
